quiz.badge: Not sure where to start? ⭐ 2-minute quiz
quiz.title: What kind of traveller are you?
quiz.subtitle: Answer 5 questions and the AI will put together a trip made to measure

uravnotezen.label: Balanced
uravnotezen.desc: A mix of calm and movement

autumn.label: Autumn
autumn.desc: Colours and the bora in the vineyards

narava.label: Nature Lover
narava.desc: Peace, fresh air and trails that end by a lake. Your Slovenia: Triglav National Park, the Soča and Bohinj.

hrana.label: Foodie
hrana.desc: You travel with your stomach. Your Slovenia: inns serving local ingredients and the wine roads of Štajerska and Dolenjska.

adrenalin.label: Adventurer
adrenalin.desc: Adrenaline is your fuel. Your Slovenia: rafting on the Soča, canyoning in the gorges and skiing on Vogel.

kultura.label: Culture Seeker
kultura.desc: History and the buzz of a city make you happy. Your Slovenia: Ljubljana, Ptuj, Celje and Piran.

budget.label: Budget Explorer
budget.desc: You see a lot, you spend little. Your Slovenia: free trails, public transport and local markets.

luxury.label: Luxury Traveller
luxury.desc: No compromises. Your Slovenia: wellness spas, premium tastings and hotel experiences.
